column1: # FinGraph merchant directory: Cayman businesses and common online services.
# KEYWORDS<TAB>Name<TAB>Category[<TAB>fallback] — keywords are matched as whole words against the statement text
# (case, apostrophes and punctuation ignored; a trailing S is allowed). Alternatives are separated
# by |. When several entries match, the one with the longest keyword wins, so
# "FOSTERS PHARMACY" beats "FOSTERS". Categories must exist in FinGraph's category list.
# `fallback` marks a payment platform (GOOGLE, APPLE.COM/BILL): it applies only when no other entry matches.
# One entry per service: entries are treated as one merchant across spellings, so a rule for one
# applies to every keyword in its entry.
# Never add a generic word on its own (MARKET, CAYMAN, GRILL, CAMANA BAY): it would catch other merchants.
HEALTH SERVICES AUTH|HEALTH SERVICES AUTHORITY|CAYMAN ISLANDS HOSPITAL|HSA
A L THOMPSON|AL THOMPSON|ALTHOMPSON|A L THOMPSONS
KIRK HOME CENTRE|KIRK HOME CENTER|KIRK HOME
# ── Amazon: the store is shopping, its digital services are subscriptions
AMAZON|AMZN|AMAZON COM|AMZN COM|AMAZON MKTPL|AMZN MKTP|AMAZON MKTPLACE|AMAZON MARKETPLACE
AMAZON DIGIT|AMAZON DIGITAL|AMZN DIGITAL|AMAZON DIGITAL SVCS
AA RUBIS|AA RED BAY|AA REDBAY|AA SEVEN MILE|AA 7 MILE
# ── Google: Google Play / plain GOOGLE are fallbacks, so the service named after them wins
# ── Apple: APPLE.COM/BILL is the App Store / iCloud / Apple One
